subject: intr
title: (R)INTR.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart on book p. 261 (PR.S(RD)II-15). INTR (interpretation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From the subject: POL-CON (political consciousness), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and SCI-DY (scientific dynamics). From POL-CON: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From VT-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and COS-P (cosmic particulars). From SCI-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) and BIA (bi-aitional).
